elements.name: Resident fills in indienen-aansprakelijkheid-behandelen open-forms form

steps.name: Resident "Alice" fills in the indienen-aansprakelijkheid-behandelen open-forms form
Resident "Alice" submits the open-forms form
"Bob" is logged in to zac
Employee "Bob" opens the zaak that was created from the open-forms submission
Employee "Bob" sees the zaak that "Alice" created in open-forms

elements.name: Employee wants to create a new document for a zaak Using the SmartDocuments wizard

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
"Bob" wants to create a new "CMMN" zaak
Employee "Bob" clicks on Create Document button for the new zaak
Employee "Bob" enters and submits the form to start the SmartDocuments wizard
Employee "Bob" completes the SmartDocuments wizard
Employee "Bob" closes the wizard result page
Employee "Bob" views the created document
Employee "Bob" sees all added details in the created document meta data

elements.name: Employee "Bob" does not have enough information to finish Intake and assigns a task to Employee "Oscar"

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
"Bob" wants to create a new "CMMN" zaak
Employee "Bob" is on the newly created zaak with status "Intake"
Employee "Bob" does not have enough information to finish Intake and assigns a task to Employee "Oscar"
Employee "Bob" logs out of zac
"Oscar" is logged in to zac
Employee "Oscar" sees the task assigned to them by Employee "Bob" in my task list
Employee "Oscar" is on the newly created zaak with status "Wacht op aanvullende informatie"
Employee "Oscar" sees the task assigned to them by Employee "Bob" in the newly created zaak tasks list

elements.name: Bob assigns zaken to a group and user from the list

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
"Bob" navigates to "zac" with path "/zaken/werkvoorraad"
the page is done searching
there are at least 3 zaken
"Bob" selects that number of zaken
"Bob" assigns the zaken to group "Test groep A" and user "Bob"
"Bob" gets a message confirming that the assigning of zaken is starting
after a while the snackbar disappears

elements.name: Bob releases zaken from the list

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
"Bob" navigates to "zac" with path "/zaken/werkvoorraad"
the page is done searching and reloaded
there are at least 3 zaken
"Bob" selects that number of zaken
"Bob" releases the zaken
"Bob" gets a message confirming that the releasing of zaken is starting
after a while the snackbar disappears

elements.name: Bob assigns taken to a group and user from the list

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
"Bob" navigates to "zac" with path "/taken/werkvoorraad"
the page is done searching
there are at least 3 taken
"Bob" selects that number of taken
"Bob" assigns the taken to the first group and user available
"Bob" gets a message confirming that the assigning of taken is starting
after a while the snackbar disappears
"Bob" is logged in to zac
"Bob" navigates to "zac" with path "/taken/werkvoorraad"
the page is done searching and reloaded
there are at least 3 taken
"Bob" selects that number of taken
"Bob" releases the taken
"Bob" gets a message confirming that the releasing of taken is starting
after a while the snackbar disappears

elements.name: Bob wants to view a person

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
"Bob" wants to create a new "CMMN" zaak
"Bob" sees the created zaak
"Bob" sees the zaak initiator
"Bob" is logged in to zac
Employee "Bob" is on the newly created zaak
"Bob" navigates to initiator details page
"Bob" sees the person

elements.name: Bob wants to set up the BPMN processdefinition

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
"Bob" navigates to "zac" with path "/admin/bpmn-procesdefinities"
"Bob" uploads the E2E test processdefinition
"Bob" uploads all of the forms of the E2E test processdefinition
"Bob" sees that the processdefinition is correctly setup

elements.name: Bob wants to create a new BPMN zaak

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
"Bob" wants to create a new "BPMN" zaak
"Bob" sees the created zaak
"Bob" navigates to "zac" with path "/zaken/werkvoorraad"
"Bob" sees the created zaak

elements.name: Bob changes the assigned user and group

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
Employee "Bob" is on the newly created zaak
"Bob" sees group "Test groep A" and user "e2etestuser1" in the zaak data
Employee "Bob" assigns the zaak to group "Test groep B" and user "E2etest User2"
"Bob" sees group "Test groep B" and user "e2etestuser2" in the zaak data

elements.name: Bob opens the initial task form

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
Employee "Bob" is on the newly created zaak
"Bob" opens the "MultipleFormItems" task
"Bob" sees the form associated with the task

elements.name: Bob creates two SmartDocuments Word files

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
Employee "Bob" is on the newly created zaak
"Bob" opens the "MultipleFormItems" task
"Bob" creates a SmartDocuments Word file named "file A"
"Bob" reloads the page
"Bob" sees document "file A" in the documents list
"Bob" creates a SmartDocuments Word file named "file B"
"Bob" reloads the page
"Bob" sees document "file B" in the documents list

elements.name: Bob fills-in and submits the task form

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
Employee "Bob" is on the newly created zaak
"Bob" opens the "MultipleFormItems" task
"Bob" sees the desired form fields values
"Bob" fills all mandatory form fields
"Bob" submits the filled-in form
Employee "Bob" is on the newly created zaak
"Bob" sees that the initial task is completed
"Bob" sees that the MultipleFormItemsSummary task is started with group "Test groep A" and user "E2etest User1"

elements.name: Bob opens documents grid form and selects two out of three documents

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
Employee "Bob" is on the newly created zaak
"Bob" adds document "File C" to the zaak
"Bob" adds document "File D" to the zaak
"Bob" adds document "File E" to the zaak
"Bob" opens the "Select documents to sign" task
"Bob" sees the select documents to sign form
"Bob" selects document "File C" for signing
"Bob" selects document "File D" for signing
"Bob" submits the filled-in form

elements.name: Bob verifies that there are two documents to sign selects one to sign and submits

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
Employee "Bob" is on the newly created zaak
"Bob" opens the "Verify documents to sign" task
"Bob" sees 2 document(s) in the to be signed list
"Bob" sees document "File C" in the to be signed list
"Bob" sees document "File D" in the to be signed list
"Bob" selects document "File C" to be signed
"Bob" submits the filled-in form
Employee "Bob" is on the newly created zaak
"Bob" sees document "File C" has been signed

elements.name: Bob inspects the summary task form

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
Employee "Bob" is on the newly created zaak
"Bob" opens the "MultipleFormItemsSummary" task
"Bob" sees that the summary form contains all filled-in data

elements.name: Bob confirms the data in the summary form

steps.name: "Bob" is logged in to zac
Employee "Bob" is on the newly created zaak
"Bob" opens the "MultipleFormItemsSummary" task
"Bob" confirms the data in the form
Employee "Bob" is on the newly created zaak with status "Afgerond"
"Bob" sees the zaak result is set to "Verleend"
